items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: The interviewee only responds 'Good for him' to the interviewer's story about Jack Sheldon sitting in with the interviewer and Uan Rasey. There is no evidence the interviewee knew or interacted with Jack Sheldon.

ctx.x: It was the first time in 30 years. He got his trumpet, he went to Uan Rasey for a week, and he came and sat in with Jack Sheldon and myself at the Money Tree last Sunday © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
night. He said, “This is the first time I’ve played in 30 years.” He got himself a brand new beautiful trumpet.
